request.summary: Create a calm public-facing venue pulse for the fictional Foundry Arts Center using one built-in calendar program source and one independent built-in feed announcement source.
request.audience: Visitors in the Foundry Arts Center lobby or compact venue display zones who need to understand what is happening now or next.
request.primaryGoal: Make the current or next program unmistakable while one timely announcement supports it as part of the same composed venue surface.

assumptions: The two requested production placements are the only supported canvases: 1920x1080 and 800x480.
The venue is fictional, and all bundled sample records, IDs, links, and timestamps are synthetic.

The app should keep independent calendar and feed refresh lifecycles; a feed update must not reset program rotation, and a calendar update must not reset announcement rotation unless the active item disappears.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The task explicitly limits usage to two landscape signage canvases, so the composition is optimized for 1920x1080 and 800x480 without unsupported fallback ratios.

surfaces.purpose: Compact landscape venue display that may remove imagery and secondary prose.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, wrap to three lines and clamp after preserving time and state.
dynamicText.rationale: The current or next program title is the essential message and must remain dominant on both target surfaces.

dynamicText.fallback: Clamp after two lines while preserving the program title and time.
dynamicText.rationale: The announcement supports the program but cannot compete with or displace it.

dynamicText.fallback: Ellipsize the tail before reducing essential program time or title size.
dynamicText.rationale: Configured labels identify the board but are secondary to the live program.

states.expectation: The light preset presents a calm gallery-lobby surface with one dominant program and a supporting announcement.
The dark preset keeps the same hierarchy with coordinated contrast.
Microsoft-style calendar events and current feed items normalize into the full HD composition.
Overlapping Google/Microsoft-style programs keep the active program unmistakable and rotate only among valid program candidates.
iCalendar and legacy RSS feed wrappers normalize into the same model.
A valid calendar with no announcements still renders a complete program-first venue pulse.
A valid announcement feed without calendar programs renders a clear announcement-led fallback.
Both empty sources render the configured quiet empty state.
Long program titles, missing locations, rich text summaries, and long announcement copy remain contained.
All-day programs use an all-day label instead of misleading clock ranges.
Broken media is hidden and stale announcements are not selected when fresher items exist.
Calendar refreshes update current/next state without resetting announcement rotation.
Feed refreshes update the announcement without resetting active program rotation.

behaviors.expectation: Microsoft, Google, iCalendar, current feed, and legacy RSS shapes produce one typed program-plus-announcement model.
Calendar and feed updates apply independently without unnecessary rotation resets.
Overlapping and upcoming programs rotate on the configured cadence while preserving the active/next state label.
A calendar datasource refresh replaces the visible program content in place.
A feed datasource refresh replaces the visible announcement content in place.

visualDirection.summary: A calm civic arts venue pulse that merges program and announcement into one editorial signage composition rather than adjacent dashboards.
signatureChoices: One oversized program field occupies the visual center, with announcement text tucked into the same diagonal rhythm.
Warm gallery-neutral palettes use restrained ink, copper, and soft gold accents rather than operational dashboard colors.
avoid: Generic news layout with unrelated article rail

visualReview.intent: A public arts-center board where visitors immediately know the active or next program, with one timely support announcement integrated into the same surface.
focus: Verify the featured program is unmistakably stronger than the announcement at 1920x1080 and 800x480.
Verify the compact surface removes imagery and secondary prose before shrinking essential time and title text.
Verify light and dark themes feel coordinated and all long text remains contained with visible descenders.
